title: Delocalizing a resolution at a prime of height zero
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $A$ an $R$-algebra of finite presentation, $A\to\Lambda$ a homomorphism of $R$-algebras and $\mathfrak q\subset\Lambda$ a prime ideal, with $\mathfrak h_A=\sqrt{H_{A/R}\Lambda}$ as in [def-weil-pbc-popescu-resolution]. Let $\mathfrak p\subset R$ be the inverse image of $\mathfrak q$, $R_{\mathfrak p}$ and $\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$ the localizations [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and $A_{\mathfrak p}=A\otimes_RR_{\mathfrak p}$ (of finite presentation over $R_{\mathfrak p}$, with the induced map $A_{\mathfrak p}\to\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$). Assume (1) $\mathfrak q$ is minimal over $\mathfrak h_A$; (2) $R_{\mathfrak p}\to A_{\mathfrak p}\to\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}\supset\mathfrak q\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$ can be resolved [def-weil-pbc-popescu-resolution]; (3) $\dim\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}=0$. Then $R\to A\to\Lambda\supset\mathfrak q$ can be resolved.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07FA (lemma-delocalize-height-zero, line 2230), Section 07F6 (section-local)
